analysis.primary_estimand: Arithmetic mean of three per-training-seed complete pooled-OOF projected-minus-rowsoftmax trapezoidal PR-AUC differences.
analysis.secondary_metric: MCC at each fitted projected/rowsoftmax arm seed own saved pooled-OOF development-selected threshold.
seed_variability: count of positive, zero and negative deltas

bootstrap.complex_sampling: with replacement; include all sample/residue rows and each drawn complex multiplicity
bootstrap.group_order: sorted unique complex codes after stripping whitespace and uppercasing
bootstrap.statistic: Compute each seed projected-minus-rowsoftmax metric difference on the common sampled complexes, then average those three differences.
bootstrap.thresholds: hold every fitted arm/seed saved threshold fixed
bootstrap.missing_or_nonfinite_predictions: fail validation; never exclude as bootstrap draws
bootstrap.scope: conditional on all fitted predictions; does not include training-seed uncertainty
bootstrap.bootstrap_rerun_policy: Refuse rerun or overwrite of a completed aggregate.

analysis.secondary_estimand: Arithmetic mean of the three projected-minus-rowsoftmax MCC differences.
analysis.descriptive_estimand: AUROC projected-minus-rowsoftmax per seed and its mean, ddof=1 sample SD, range and sign counts; no AUROC interval.
analysis.historical_reference_reporting: Observed seed-2101 and three-seed OT/no-OT results separately labeled descriptive context; no historical predictions, checkpoints, scores or thresholds enter the prospective aggregate or bootstrap.
